data.long_meaning: One who shows compassion, mercy, and kindness to others. The name Rakhumah carries the meaning “The Giver of Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rakhumah usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver of mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine attribute of mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Rakhumah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Giver of Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakhumah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rakhumah" holds significant cultural importance in Islamic society as it represents the ideal Islamic character of being compassionate and merciful towards others. In Islam, showing kindness and compassion towards fellow human beings is one of the essential obligations for a believer. The name serves as a constant reminder of this virtue and encourages its bearer to embody it in their daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Rakhumah" also holds great significance as it connects its bearer to the infinite mercy and compassion of Allah (God). The Islamic belief asserts that God is the most merciful and compassionate entity who grants forgiveness to those who seek His mercy. By adopting the name "Rakhumah," one is not only called upon to exhibit this quality towards others but also to seek Allah's mercy and compassion for themselves. In this sense, the name "Rakhumah" is a constant reminder of both the ethical behavior required of Muslims towards others and their spiritual quest for Allah's mercy and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Giver of Mercy" symbolizes One who shows compassion, mercy, and kindness to others.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rakhumah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the giver of mercy.
